newsitem.title: USA: American Oilfield seeks Hard Suits.
newsitem.headline: American Oilfield seeks Hard Suits.

text.p: American Oilfield Divers Inc said Wednesday it has offered to purchase for cash all of Hard Suits Inc's outstanding common shares at a price of C$1.50 per share, for a total purchase price of about C$15 million -- or about U.S. $10.9 million.
Hard Suits manufactures the Newtsuit, a one atmosphere diving suit, and other subsea robotic products.
American Oilfield said its offer is scheduled to expire at 0001 CDT/4001 GMT October 17, 1996.
The company said it will satisfy the offer's cash requirements from available working capital and from funds to be advanced under its bank line in a principal amount equivalent to C$19 million.

The offer is conditional upon, among other things, at least 50.1 percent of the voting rights attaching to all of the common shares and Class "A" Performance Shares of Hard Suits being tendered and upon the Hard Suits' board being reconstituted to reflect American Oilfield's majority shareholding.

"It is our intent to continue Hard Suits operations as an independent business based in Vancouver due to the potential of its product lines and the synergies which exist with our existing businesses" said American Oilfield chief executive George Yax.
"It will also allow the existing shareholders of Hard Suits to realize a premium to the current market price of the Common Shares." -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.
